day_shape: State Dept and Treasury roll out Operation Economic Outcast sanctions on 17 shadow-fleet vessels, Trump rules out pre-midterm strike on Iran while Pentagon reportedly told to be ready, Khamenei issues heavy Police Week message cycle, Putin-Pezeshkian meet in Turkmenistan.

threads.label: Operation Economic Outcast shadow-fleet sanctions
threads.summary: The State Department and Treasury announced fresh designations under Operation Economic Outcast targeting Iran's oil shipping network. Iran International reported 17 vessels and their owners were sanctioned, which US officials said neutralises most of Iran's remaining shadow fleet.

threads.label: Trump signals no pre-midterm Iran strike
threads.summary: Trump said the US will not attack Iran before November's midterm elections and described talks with Tehran as productive. Times of Israel cited Axios reporting the Pentagon was told days ago to be ready to resume military operations against Iran, and Iran's FM Araghchi said Tehran would soon respond on a Strait of Hormuz proposal.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz posturing
threads.summary: CENTCOM briefed international shipping partners on the Strait of Hormuz in a virtual discussion and announced USS Abraham Lincoln's return after a Middle East deployment covering 90,000 miles. IRGC figures Izadi and Vahidi said on Defa Press that Iran's forces are fully prepared to defend Hormuz and that no extra-regional power has the right to intervene.

threads.label: Khamenei Police Week message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office pushed a sustained series of posts carrying his Police Week message praising FARAJA's role in what he called the second and third imposed wars against the US-Israeli enemy. IRIB and Defa Press amplified the message alongside the Defence Ministry spokesman's claim that weapons production rose 2.5-fold during the war.

threads.label: Putin-Pezeshkian meeting in Turkmenistan
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported Pezeshkian met Putin in Turkmenistan on the margins of CIS and Caspian summits, with Putin asking him to convey greetings to Khamenei. The regime outlets cited 21% growth in Iran-Russia trade in 2025 and quoted Pezeshkian rejecting US unilateralism.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas commanders in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF announced it had killed Muhammad Muhsen Nimr Yazji, a Shati Battalion commander involved in holding former hostages Emily Damari, Romi Gonen and Matan Angrest, along with another Daraj Tuffah operative. A separate IDF statement reported the killing of Ibrahim Alam, a Hamas commander who took part in the October 7 attack and the abduction of Sgt Shaked Dahan's body.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Riyadh and regional response
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Houthi strikes on Riyadh disrupted flights and prompted work-from-home orders, with Turkey assessing how to help Saudi Arabia under its defence pact with Pakistan and US envoy Tom Barrack meeting Syria's FM in Istanbul amid speculation Damascus could aid Riyadh. Defa Press carried Houthi leader Abdul Malik al-Houthi's speech marking the tenth anniversary of the Sanaa hall massacre.
